book.name: iLuku
book.title: Esɔ Osuse mi abɔ mgbi iLuku

content: IYesu kɛ udɛ inggisɛ iFarasi
Egbe otonyidɔ oka nɛ, iYesu kɛ le ka gye oga mi udɛ mgbi inggisɛ iFarasi imɔ oka, a si kye inɛ fyakwun.
Nɛta inggisɛ oka ngwu afɔ yi abɔ weeni ba mbi iYesu.
Nɛ iYesu byi ama otso ola mgbi iMose bɛyi emi iFarasi ita gbɛɛ, <<Ola mgbi eyi noofɛ ongyɛlu ootse mi egbe otonyidɔ naadi i nu ba?>>
Kpaa a dede shilididi. Ta iYesu byi inggisɛ na abɔ, man o ngyɛlun ootse di dzanta non lu.
IYesu si byi emi iFarasi ntona gbɛɛ, <<Ni onyi mbi ema dzɛ yi ongwɛ naadi mnda ngbɛsɛ wokɛ ibuga mi egbe otonyidɔ ma, o ka dulun tɔ plɛ lo?>>
Nghaduu a yagba nu uka ba.
IYesu gbɔdzɛ mgbi ewo oyile esɛ
Ngwi iYesu difwi dafi ama nba oga ntonɛ le sadu imbe mmwɛ abuoma nɛ, o nya ma utsa nɛ gbɛɛ:
<<Ni inggisɛ bɔ abu oga mgbi eba okwokyiikwokyi yɔ, ka sisɛ mi imbe mmwɛ ba. Ikyayina inggisɛ oka nshewo ngha abu kpaa a bɔɔn.
Ni li ngha, inggisɛ nbɔ ema ma, ka ba wa nya abu gbɛɛ, <Ni abu kye itse mgbi abu nu inggisɛ nɛni.> Ta abu ka tu ayiwi yɛ ka sɔkɛ imbe okwushanyɛ.

Nghaduu, nu ma bɔ abu oga yɔ, lu ka sɔkɛ imbe ngwi yɛ esɛ tsatsadu mani, ni inggisɛ nbɔ abu wa nya abu gbɛɛ, <Kyato, okani, lu itse ntatase nani.> Ta abu ka dzɛ yi mmwɛ mi inɛ mbi ama ngwu a bɔ ma ntonani.
Lubana ali inggisɛ nkyile ewon esho duu a ka yilen esɛ. Kpaa ongwu n yile ewon esɛ, a ka kyilen esho.>>

Ta iYesu si nya inggisɛ nbɔɔn oga na gbɛɛ, <<Ni abu kyɔ oga mi onɔ naadi onɔnɔdɛ, ka bɔ emi okaabu ba naadi emi ongwunabu naadi odo abu hona emi aludu ama nwatse dɔ abu ba; ikyena a ka yidɔ bɔ abu ikye oyilen kpaa abu mkpaa.
Ni abu kyɔ oga yɔ, bɔ emi adzɛ, yi ama ngbikye tukwu esɛ, yi ama ntummya, yi ama nbinɛ,
ta Imgbasho ka kye mse bɛ abu ewo. Ikyekyɛ a ka yagba kpa abu mkpa gbɛ ba, Imgbasho ka yilen kpa abu mi egbe ngwi emi osaan ka kyato mi ikwu mani.>>
Utsa mgbi andɛfɛ oga
Onɔ ngwi inggisɛ onyi mbi ama nsɔto oga biyan fwo odzɛ nɛ nɛ, o nya iYesu gbɛɛ, <<Inggisɛ nka sɔ oga mi esutɔ mgbi Imgbasho ka gbumse.>>
IYesu nyan gbɛɛ: <<Inggisɛ oka nose le kyɔ andɛfɛ oga si bɔ inggisɛ kwuba.
Ngwi onɔ oga ma wa gyɔ nɛ, o dɔ ongye ogbɛsɔ mgban gbɛɛ no kɛ ka nya ama ngwu ongwu bɔ ma gbɛɛ, <Ba na, lubana alungwɔ duu ngyɛ le fɛ-fɛ wa.>
<<Kpaa ama duu wita o nu itɔdzɛ idzidza-dzidza. Ongwu ababɔ nya ongye ogbɛsɔ gbɛɛ, <Ani gya ikpɛsɛ, ma li kyɛmɛ ngwi ani ka ka kpadi. N tɛkyɛ nu abu, nu ani ofɛ.>
<<Oka gbɛɛ, <Ani gya mnda efefa imbe eda, n kwa le ka mbadi ma aani. Tsuutsu nu ani ofɛ.>
<<Oka di gbɛɛ, <Ani kwa kye ongyaa ofufɛ, nghanɛ n ka yagba kɛ ba.>

<<Ongye ogbɛsɔ nɛ yidɔ ka nya ongyukwo mgban odzɛ ntonɛ duu. Ta otsungwudɛ nyɛ yi itingga kpakpa man wo ongye ogbɛsɔ mgban ola gbɛɛ, <Lu emi ingɔfɛ plɛ bɛyi emi abɔfɛ mgbi igeli ka gbe emi adzɛ yi ama ntummya yi ama nbinɛ yi ama ngbikye tukwu esɛ duu ba.>
<<Ongye ogbɛsɔ na gbɛɛ, <Ongyukwo, ola ngwi abu wo na ani kyɔ mi ele wa, kpaa imbe ka dzɛ mi ikye inggisɛ angbeka.>
<<Nghanɛ ongyukwo nya ongye ogbɛsɔ gbɛɛ, <Tasɛ lu emi onɔɔfɛ bɛyi ayɛ ofɛ ka bɔ ali inggisɛ ngwu abu di duu nu ma ba, zukwu ni udɛ mgbi ani mbwo.
N nya ema, inggisɛ ama ngwu ani plɛ bɔ ma ntona onyi kpaa ka ta oga mgbi ani kpanɛ ba!> >>
Itɔdzɛ onu abu li ongwafɔ mgbi iYesu
Ibyi inggisɛ wafɔ yi iYesu le kɛ, man o kyata nya ma gbɛɛ:
<<Inggisɛ ntangwɛ otsɔn yi onɔn, owan yi ɛngbɛ mgban, emi ongwunɔn engyulɔ yi engyaa naadi oshishe mgban bayɔ, o ka li ongwafɔ mgbi ani ba.
Inggisɛ ndi kye ekwatsi mgban kyɛdɔ ani bayɔ, o ka li ongwafɔ mgbi ani ba.
<<Ni i dzɛ gbɛɛ onyi mbi ema mina o mbɛ ozu oshigbo yɔ, o ka plɛ sisɛ kyɔ mmbwo mi ungwɔ ngwi i ka kyen ombɛ ozu ma ngyɛ baa?
Bana ki non wo itozu kpaa di yagba ngyɛlu bayɔ, ali inggisɛ ndi duu ka shan isha
gbɛɛ, <Amu nɛ kwaabɔ ombɛɛmbɛ kpaa yagba ngyɛlu ba.>
<<Naadi li ali utɔ nle ka gblika yi utɔ oka. Ka tsekise sisɛ tsɛwɛ ki non ka yagba yi engyilika nghi idubu iwyo oka gblika yi utɔ ndzɛ yi engyilika nghi idubu osu ba?
Non ka yagba ba, o ka dɔ ama ogbɛsɔ mgban nu ma ka yile ide gye ngwu ma ka dzɛ mbombo yi ama mani.
Nghanɛ, inggisɛ mgbi ema ta nkye alungwɔ mgban duu nu ba, o ka li ongwafɔ mgbi ani ba.
<<Mmwaa tishi, kpaa ni mmwaa fyumfya wuba ma, a ka kyɔsinɛse non di fyumfya dafi mmwaa?
Dika tishi mi ikpɛsɛ naadi ogbagye ibwa wuba; a ka kye yangwuta. <<Inggisɛ ndzɛ yi adɔ yɔ, otsungwɔn no fwo.>>
